license_required.quote: Any person or business entity practicing or offering to practice architecture, engineering, land surveying, landscape architecture, or petroleum release assessment or remediation shall submit evidence of qualifications to the board and be licensed in accordance with the provisions of this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: The Board of Technical Professions is created to administer the provisions of this chapter.

name.quote: The Board of Technical Professions is created to administer the provisions of this chapter.

type.quote: The board shall be composed of two professional engineers, two architects, two land surveyors, and one member from the public.

umbrella_agency.quote: The Board of Technical Professions shall continue within the Department of Labor and Regulation

degree_required.value: Graduation from an accredited engineering college, university, or technical program

credential_pegged.quote: Graduation from an accredited engineering college, university, or technical program; Completion of the minimum number of years of diversified engineering experience under the supervision of a licensed professional engineer; and Successful completion of examinations.

required.quote: Completion of the minimum number of years of diversified engineering experience under the supervision of a licensed professional engineer;

experience_source.quote: Completion of the minimum number of years of diversified engineering experience under the supervision of a licensed professional engineer;

exams.name: Fundamentals of Engineering Examination
exams.notes: Required for engineering intern enrollment; may be taken during senior year of study.
exams.quote: any applicant for enrollment as an engineering intern shall provide evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has graduated from or is admitted in an accredited engineering curriculum and has passed an examination.

exams.name: Professional Engineer Licensure Examination
exams.notes: Board may require any examinations it deems necessary to determine professional minimum competency. Board may also require a take-home questionnaire on statutes, rules, professionalism, and ethics.
exams.jurisdiction: national (board may allow national vendor to administer)
exams.quote: Successful completion of examinations. The board shall promulgate rules, pursuant to chapter 1-26, to establish education, experience, and examination criteria.

interval_years.quote: A license expires two years after the date of issuance and becomes invalid on that date unless renewed by that date.

required.quote: Successfully complete all continuing professional development requirements established by the board or make a showing of good cause why the licensee was unable to comply with such requirements.

period_years.quote: A license expires two years after the date of issuance and becomes invalid on that date unless renewed by that date.

available.quote: The board may give comity consideration to any person who holds a current and valid license issued to that person for active practice by the proper authority in any state or territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or any foreign country

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current and valid license from another state, territory, DC, or foreign country based on requirements not conflicting with SD provisions and of a standard not lower than SD's. Board may require additional examinations. Comity fee not to exceed $200.
requirements.quote: based on requirements that do not conflict with the provisions of this chapter and are of a standard not lower than that specified in the applicable licensure act in effect in this state at the time the license was issued.

exists.quote: The board shall be composed of two professional engineers, two architects, two land surveyors, and one member from the public.

regulatory_model.quote: No person or business entity may practice or offer to practice any of these professions, or to use in connection with that person's or business entity's name or otherwise assume, use, or advertise any title or description that may falsely convey the impression that the person is duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter unless the person is so licensed.

credential_type.quote: "License," a certificate indicating authority to practice and use titles within a profession;

is_mandatory.quote: No person or business entity may practice or offer to practice any of these professions...unless the person is so licensed.

title_protection.quote: No person may: ...Use or employ the title of...professional engineer...without being licensed in accordance with the provisions of this chapter;

scope_protection.quote: No person may: Practice, or offer to practice, the professions of engineering...in this state without being licensed or exempt in accordance with the provisions of this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has violated any statute, rule, or order that the board has issued or is empowered to enforce.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any statute, rule, or order that the board has issued or is empowered to enforce;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has engaged in conduct or acts that are fraudulent, deceptive, or dishonest whether or not related to professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in conduct or acts that are fraudulent, deceptive, or dishonest whether or not the conduct or acts relate to professional practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has engaged in conduct or acts that are negligent, incompetent, reckless, or otherwise in violation of established standards related to professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in conduct or acts that are negligent, incompetent, reckless, or otherwise in violation of established standards related to that person's professional practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has been convicted of or pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to a felony, or shown to have engaged in acts reflecting adversely on fitness to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or has pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to a felony, whether or not the person admits guilt, or has been shown to have engaged in acts or practices tending to show that the applicant or licensee is incompetent or has engaged in conduct reflecting adversely on the person's ability or fitness to engage in that person's professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has employed fraud or deception in obtaining a license, renewal, or in passing an examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed fraud or deception in obtaining a license or renewal of a license or in passing all or a portion of the examination;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has had professional license or similar rights revoked, suspended, canceled, or disciplined in any state, territory, DC, or foreign country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had that person's professional license, registration, certificate, right to examination, or other similar rights to practice revoked, suspended, canceled, given probation, limited, censured, reprimanded, or not renewed for cause in any state or territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or in any foreign country;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to meet any requirement for issuance or renewal of the license or certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to meet any requirement for issuance or renewal of the person's license or certificate;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has used or attempted to use as that person's own the certificate or seal of another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has used or attempted to use as that person's own the certificate or seal of another;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has used or attempted to use an expired, suspended, or revoked license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has used or attempted to use an expired, suspended, or revoked license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has placed seal or signature on a plan, specification, report, plat, or other technical submission not prepared by that person or under their responsible charge.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has placed that person's seal or signature to a plan, specification, report, plat, or other technical submission or document not prepared by that person or under that person's responsible charge;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aided or assisted another person in violating any provision of the chapter or its rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aided or assisted another person in violating any provision of this chapter or the rules pertaining to this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to promptly and appropriately provide information requested by the board as a result of a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to promptly and appropriately provide information requested by the board as a result of a formal or informal complaint to the board which would indicate a violation of this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has provided false testimony or information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has provided false testimony or information to the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report known violations of the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to report known violations of this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has engaged in the use of untruthful or improbable statements in advertisements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use of untruthful or improbable statements in advertisements;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to complete continuing professional development requirements set by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to complete continuing professional development requirements set by the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made misleading or untruthful representations in advertisements or published materials.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made misleading or untruthful representations in advertisements or published materials;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely used any title, figures, letters, or descriptions to imply licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely used any title, figures, letters, or descriptions to imply licensure;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Is habitually intoxicated or is addicted to the use of alcohol or illegal drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is habitually intoxicated or is addicted to the use of alcohol or illegal drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has committed an act, engaged in conduct, or committed practices that may result in an immediate threat to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed an act, engaged in conduct, or committed practices that may result in an immediate threat to the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has provided professional services in technical areas not covered by that person's license or competency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has provided professional services in technical areas not covered by that person's license or competency.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Any business entity that desires to practice engineering, architecture, land surveying, landscape architecture, or petroleum release assessment or remediation in this state shall register with the board by making application for a certificate of authorization.

definition_quote.value: the term, practice of engineering, means the practice or offering to practice of any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such services or creative work.
definition_quote.quote: the term, practice of engineering, means the practice or offering to practice of any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such services or creative work.

value: design coordination of engineering works and systems
planning the use of land and water
teaching of advanced engineering design subjects
methods_authorized.quote: Such service or work includes consultation; investigation; evaluation; planning; design; and design coordination of engineering works and systems; planning the use of land and water; land-use studies; teaching of advanced engineering design subjects; performing engineering studies; and the review or observation of construction for the purpose to determine whether the work is in general accordance with drawings, specifications, and other technical submissions.

covers_land_surveying.quote: The board shall be composed of two professional engineers, two architects, two land surveyors, and one member from the public.

covers_geology.quote: Any person or business entity practicing or offering to practice architecture, engineering, land surveying, landscape architecture, or petroleum release assessment or remediation shall submit evidence of qualifications to the board and be licensed in accordance with the provisions of this chapter.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineering intern" or "engineer-in-training" or "EI" or "EIT," a person enrolled by the board as an engineering intern and who has successfully passed the fundamentals of engineering examination;

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: "Land surveying intern" or "land surveyor-in-training" or "LSI" or "LSIT," a person enrolled by the board as a land surveying intern who has successfully passed the fundamentals of land surveying examination;

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge," the immediate and responsible direction by a licensed professional who has exercised personal direction, guidance, and control over the design, preparation of documents, construction administration, and other professional services and has exercised professional judgment in all matters relating to those services;

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Any licensed professional engineer, architect, land surveyor, and landscape architect shall use an appropriate seal.

seal_document_types.quote: All originals, copies, tracings, electronic submittals, or other reproductions of all final drawings, specifications, reports, plats, plans, land surveys, design information, and calculations prepared by the licensee or under the licensee's responsible charge when presented to a client or any public or governmental agency.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: Any business entity that desires to practice engineering, architecture, land surveying, landscape architecture, or petroleum release assessment or remediation in this state shall register with the board by making application for a certificate of authorization.

State and political subdivision employees practicing engineering exclusively for their employer (with building size limitations)

Full-time employees of a corporation, partnership, firm, business entity, or public utility doing work exclusively for the employer in connection with their property, products, and services

Persons preparing plans for certain building types at or below specified square footage thresholds
Persons preparing detailed or shop plans for a contractor, and construction superintendents supervising work designed by a licensed engineer
Contractors providing design-build services through licensed architects or engineers
Petroleum release business entities providing certain services as part of authorized corrective actions
Pre-engineered or predesigned building suppliers with licensed engineers on staff
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter does not apply to: (1) Any person engaged in military engineering while rendering service exclusively for any of the armed forces of the United States or this state;

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The adoption of a code of professional conduct.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Federal government officers and employees practicing engineering in official capacity
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person engaged in the practice of engineering, architecture, landscape architecture, or land surveying in the employ of the United States government but only while exclusively engaged as a United States government employee on such government project or projects which lie within federally-owned land;

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Contractors executing work designed by a licensed engineer (construction execution only)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person who prepares detailed or shop plans required to be furnished by a contractor to a registered professional engineer or architect, and any construction superintendent supervising the execution of work designed by an architect or professional engineer registered in accordance with this chapter;

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Building trades workers, craft workers, and construction superintendents/supervisors/inspectors performing customary duties
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: any construction superintendent supervising the execution of work designed by an architect or professional engineer registered in accordance with this chapter;

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Employees or subordinates working under direct supervision of a licensed engineer
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any employee who prepares technical submissions or administers construction contracts for a person or organization lawfully engaged in the practice of engineering, architecture, landscape architecture, or land surveying, if the employee is under the direct supervision of a registered professional engineer, architect, landscape architect, or land surveyor;

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineers-in-training / engineer interns acting under supervision
Land surveyor interns
Teaching engineering, architectural, landscape architectural, or surveying courses at accredited institutions
Regulated transportation companies and public utilities (and their officers and employees) performing engineering for their own facilities
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any full-time employee of a corporation, partnership, firm, business entity, or public utility while exclusively doing work for the corporation, partnership, firm, business entity, or public utility, if the work performed is in connection with the property, products, and services utilized by the employer and not for any corporation, partnership, firm, or business entity practicing or offering to practice architectural, engineering, landscape architecture, or land surveying services to the public.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineering services incidental to the practice of architecture by licensed architects and their subordinates
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: An architect may engage in the practice of professional engineering, or a professional engineer may engage in the practice of architecture, but only to the extent that such practice is incidental or of minor importance to a project or service being legally performed under this chapter.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineering services incidental to the practice of geology by licensed geologists and their subordinates
Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade
Manufacturing, mining, public utility, research and development, or other industrial corporations performing engineering work incidental to their own products, systems, or services
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any full-time employee of a corporation, partnership, firm, business entity, or public utility while exclusively doing work for the corporation, partnership, firm, business entity, or public utility, if the work performed is in connection with the property, products, and services utilized by the employer

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Firms performing engineering services for themselves or their own subsidiaries/affiliates (in-house engineering)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any full-time employee of a corporation, partnership, firm, business entity, or public utility while exclusively doing work for the corporation, partnership, firm, business entity, or public utility, if the work performed is in connection with the property, products, and services utilized by the employer and not for any corporation, partnership, firm, or business entity practicing or offering to practice architectural, engineering, landscape architecture, or land surveying services to the public.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Nonresident persons, firms, or corporations meeting specified out-of-state criteria
Real estate brokers or salespersons making appraisals and valuations of real estate
Alterations or repairs to buildings not affecting structural system or public health, safety, or welfare
Single-family and small residential dwellings of limited size
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person engaged in the preparation of plans and specifications for the erection, enlargement, or alteration of any of the following buildings: (a) Any dwelling for a single family, and any outbuilding in connection therewith, such as a barn or private garage; (b) Any two, three, or four family dwelling;

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Agricultural work not required to be of public record
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any farm or ranch building or accessory thereto except any building regularly used for public purposes;

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Revegetation, restoration, reclamation, rehabilitation, or erosion control for disturbed land not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Maintenance or placement of plant material not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Horticultural consultants and persons preparing planting plans for plant installations
Authorized designers of fire protection systems
Holders of temporary permits for engineering practice
Corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and LLPs offering professional engineering services through licensed principals (business entity exemption with certificate of authorization)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: "Business entity," any corporation, partnership, limited liability corporation, limited liability partnership, or sole proprietorship that practices or offers to practice engineering, architecture, land surveying, landscape architecture, petroleum release assessment, or petroleum release remediation services to the public through its licensed personnel who are either employees, officers, directors, partners, members, managers, or owners and that have been issued a certificate of authorization by the board;

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Government employees inspecting residential structures as part of official duties
Persons performing home inspections solely for lender construction monitoring
Property managers inspecting their own managed residential structures without separate compensation
Small public works projects below a specified expenditure threshold
Licensed geologists practicing geology (not required to hold engineer license)
Persons with grandfathered or legacy licensure status in discontinued engineering branch titles
Boundary surveys on private land not intended as basis for engineering design
Professional engineers or engineer interns granted inactive status
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: No inactive licensee may practice or offer to practice professional services in South Dakota unless otherwise exempted in this chapter.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Senior licensed professional engineers exempt from continuing education requirements
